name: Algebraic State Reduction
description: Transforms a 2-machine flow-shop makespan problem into a mathematically equivalent single-state buffer minimization over permutations. By proving that the makespan equals the final buffer size plus the sum of all first-stage times, we replace all scheduling affordances with an algebraic state update rule (E = max(E - a, 0) + b). Models relying on scheduling keywords or standard problem templates will fail to recognize Johnson's rule, while those capable of algebraic derivation can still deduce the optimal comparator.
